BiblicalUsage: The king made pillars of almug trees for the house of the Lord and for the king's house, and the word is the balustrade itself, the stair rail of the temple. It is named once, among the wonders of Solomon's building.
TheologicalSignificance: I notice that even a stair rail in Solomon's temple is worth naming: the house of the Lord was finished down to the last rail, and no part of it was left plain.
